newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks close firm in strong volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks close firm in strong volume.

text.p: Argentine stocks closed with a firm tone Tuesday and dealers said the good trading volume was a reflection of investor confidence that current gains would continue in the medium term at least.
The blue-chip MerVal index MERV was 1.11 percent higher at 818.40, after posting 1.39 percent gains in earlier trade.
Leading shares proved the top investment in Argentina in June, growing 4.03 percent on the month and 25 percent in the first half of the year.
Volume was sharply higher Tuesday at 36.6 million pesos compared to the weak 20.8 million pesos in Monday's session.

"The market is showing a consolidated bullish tendency in the medium and long term, which means investors are seeing good prospects for capital reflected in sustained good volume," said dealer Jose Ansa.
Dealers said the U.S. Federal Reserve's meeting was having little impact on local sentiment as the market had virtually ruled out any change in policy.
The best gainss were for construction and gas transport stocks, dealers said, and the strongest rises were for Juan Minetti, up 3.12 percent, and Polledo, up 3.17 percent.
